description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Order made to grant Permission to Persons resident in Sri Lanka who held NRFC, R.F.C, RNNFC and FEEA to acquire hold and Transfer Securities issued outside Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal notice issued under the Exchange Control Act, granting specific permissions regarding foreign currency accounts and securities transactions. It constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only his title "Minister of Finance"), and the primary content is regulatory rather than about government personnel or structure.
